answer.rationale: Do not answer the competitor cut with promotional pricing: the directly recovered SMB discount result increased signups and qualified revenue but reduced 30-day retention by 12%, conflicting with sustainable long-term qualified revenue. Broadly deploy the already-confirmed shortened, simplified onboarding path, which improved completion, reduced time-to-value, and increased 30-day retention. This will not by itself resolve price-driven churn among existing accounts, so that limitation remains explicit.
